name: Czech law: the Sbírka zákonů (Collection of Laws), every act of legislation with consolidated versions, from e-Sbírka's open data
label: Czechia
record_note: every consolidated version checked against e-Sbírka's open datasets as published on 2026-10-28 (Last-Modified)

dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Prague (UTC+1, UTC+2 in summer time); before 1970 git cannot store the date, so commits are dated 1970-01-01T00:00:01Z onwards, one second apart, and In-force: holds the day

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: an act applies from the day it takes effect (účinnost) and does not attach new legal consequences to facts completed before then; the prohibition follows from the rule of law (legal certainty and legitimate expectations) and admits genuine retroactivity only exceptionally; in criminal law a later act applies only where it is more favourable to the offender
default_reach.authority: Listina základních práv a svobod čl. 40 odst. 6 ("Trestnost činu se posuzuje a trest se ukládá podle zákona účinného v době, kdy byl čin spáchán. Pozdějšího zákona se použije, jestliže je to pro pachatele příznivější."); Ústava České republiky čl. 1 odst. 1 (demokratický právní stát), from which the Constitutional Court derives the principle of legal certainty
